updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID permits unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations should apply security patches immediately to prevent account compromise and unauthorized access to resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network, potentially gaining access to administrative capabilities. Prompt patching is critical to restrict privilege escalation risks in your identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network. This critical flaw poses severe risk to on-premises identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally. Administrators should prioritize applying this patch to prevent unauthorized administrative access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Expansion for Copilot + PC Devices with Recall Snapshots
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention is expanding to protect Copilot + PC devices by preventing capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and sensitive information types in Recall snapshots. Purview admins can now author custom Endpoint DLP policies integrated with Intune-managed Copilot + PC devices to enforce protection at the device level.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: DLP policies now integrate with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to intercept and filter sensitive files at the network layer before they reach untrusted cloud applications, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This enables organizations to enforce protective actions based on DLP conditions with centralized alert management through Purview.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Secure Workflow for Priority Cleanup to Bypass Legal Holds and Retention Policies
updates.summary: A new secure Priority cleanup feature enables compliance admins to create recurring exceptions for deleting items under retention policies or legal holds on Exchange, requiring a dedicated security role, multiple approvers, and full audit trail. This allows exceptions to be managed with proper governance and accountability for sensitive compliance scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Departing Employee OneDrive and Mailbox Deletion
updates.summary: Admins can now automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, eliminating manual effort and helping maintain regulatory compliance without oversight. This streamlines offboarding processes and reduces compliance risk from orphaned user data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Retention Based on Last Accessed Date for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Retention labels and policies can now be applied to OneDrive and SharePoint items based on when they were last accessed by users, enabling more granular data governance. This feature helps organizations automatically manage cold data and improve information lifecycle compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Microsoft Planner Content
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now create retention policies to manage content in Microsoft Planner, including tasks for plans associated with Microsoft 365 Groups. This extends data lifecycle management capabilities beyond traditional workloads to cover collaborative planning tools.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: Security Copilot now provides DLP admins with AI-powered summaries of DLP policies, including coverage analysis of locations, classifiers, and notifications. This enables admins to use natural language prompts to gain deeper visibility into policy configurations and align data protection posture more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP policies now extend to Microsoft Cowork, allowing data security admins to protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts with supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from web search. This unifies policy enforcement across Copilot and Cowork experiences.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Insights and Policy Recommendations for Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights and policy recommendations on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint, helping admins improve their data security and compliance posture with actionable retention policy guidance. This feature supports data-driven governance decisions based on actual sensitivity levels.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workloads, improving consistency and reducing noise in event reporting while enhancing performance. This change standardizes how Endpoint DLP treats archived content across platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Billing Model Change to Volume-Based Pricing
updates.summary: DLP billing is transitioning to a volume-based model charged per GB of retained data per month, replacing previous pricing structures. Organizations should review their DLP usage to understand cost implications of this billing change.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Box, Google Workspace)
updates.summary: DLP policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications including Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This extends data protection beyond the Microsoft ecosystem to hybrid SaaS environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to identify which items would be labeled without making changes, enabling admins to review match results and source distribution before enforcement. This reduces risk of incorrect or overly broad auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Policy Performance Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: The Insights tab in sensitivity label policy details now provides at-a-glance performance metrics that vary based on simulation or enforcement mode, helping admins understand how policies identify and label content. This improves visibility into auto-labeling effectiveness and data classification trends.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now support non-Microsoft connected apps including Box and Google Workspace using Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors with the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This extends automatic sensitivity classification beyond Microsoft 365 locations.
